# Examples for task 60

Examples with a command line are startup examples (AGENTS.md).

## Fixtures

### generated

```text tree
Cargo.lock                 2026-10-01 10:00
src/main.rs                2026-10-01 10:00
src/schema_gen.rs          2026-10-01 10:00
```

File contents are in `tests/fixtures/generated/`: `Cargo.lock` is generated by its name, `src/schema_gen.rs` by the
marker `@generated` in its first line. Times are UTC.

## E60.1 Generated files are skipped by default

Fixture: `generated`

1. `find`

```json request
{"query": "name ~ '*.rs'"}
```

```text response
files: 1  lines: 0  matches: 0  result: r1
#1 name ~ '*.rs'

src/
main.rs  [#1]
```

2. `get_config`

```json request get_config
{ "section": "traversal" }
```

```text response
# easy-peasy-mcp <version>, spec 1, supported specs: 1
# read-only: server.allowed_roots, server.allow_update

[traversal]
min_depth = 0
# max_depth =  (not set)
follow_symlinks = false
hidden = false
ignore_files = ['.gitignore', '.ignore', '.aiignore']
git_excludes = true
ignore_paths = []
exclude = []
path_case = "native"
binary = "skip"
max_file_size = "10M"
encoding = "auto"
# fallback_encoding =  (not set)
archives = "none"
max_archive_size = "100M"
skip_generated = true
```

## E60.2 Generated files returned in a request

Fixture: `generated`

```json request
{"query": "name ~ '*.rs'", "traversal": {"skip_generated": false}}
```

```text response
files: 2  lines: 0  matches: 0  result: r1
#1 name ~ '*.rs'

src/
main.rs  [#1]
schema_gen.rs  [#1]
```

## E60.3 A `kind` condition returns them whatever the setting is

Fixture: `generated`

```json request
{"query": "kind = generated"}
```

```text response
files: 2  lines: 0  matches: 0  result: r1
#1 kind = generated

./
Cargo.lock  [#1]
src/
schema_gen.rs  [#1]
```

## E60.4 Generated files for the session

Fixture: `generated`

1. `update_config`

```json request update_config
{"set": "traversal.skip_generated = false"}
```

```text response
[traversal]
skip_generated = false    # was true
```

2. `find`

```json request
{"query": "name ~ '*.rs'"}
```

```text response
files: 2  lines: 0  matches: 0  result: r1
#1 name ~ '*.rs'

src/
main.rs  [#1]
schema_gen.rs  [#1]
```

3. `get_config`

```json request get_config
{ "section": "traversal", "sources": true }
```

```text response
# easy-peasy-mcp <version>, spec 1, supported specs: 1
# read-only: server.allowed_roots, server.allow_update

[traversal]
min_depth = 0    # default
# max_depth =  (not set)    # default
follow_symlinks = false    # default
hidden = false    # default
ignore_files = ['.gitignore', '.ignore', '.aiignore']    # default
git_excludes = true    # default
ignore_paths = []    # default
exclude = []    # default
path_case = "native"    # default
binary = "skip"    # default
max_file_size = "10M"    # default
encoding = "auto"    # default
# fallback_encoding =  (not set)    # default
archives = "none"    # default
max_archive_size = "100M"    # default
skip_generated = false    # update
```

## E60.5 An invalid value in a request

Fixture: `generated`

```json request
{"traversal": {"skip_generated": "no"}}
```

```text error
error[invalid_option]: 'traversal.skip_generated' must be true or false
```

## E60.6 An invalid value for `update_config`

Fixture: `generated`

```json request update_config
{"set": "traversal.skip_generated = 0"}
```

```text error
error[invalid_value]: invalid value for 'traversal.skip_generated'
  hint: true or false is expected
```

## E60.7 From the config file

Fixture: `generated`

```toml conf/g.toml
[traversal]
skip_generated = false
```

```text command
easy-peasy-mcp --config conf/g.toml
```

1. `get_config`

```json request get_config
{ "section": "traversal", "sources": true }
```

```text response
# easy-peasy-mcp <version>, spec 1, supported specs: 1
# read-only: server.allowed_roots, server.allow_update

[traversal]
min_depth = 0    # default
# max_depth =  (not set)    # default
follow_symlinks = false    # default
hidden = false    # default
ignore_files = ['.gitignore', '.ignore', '.aiignore']    # default
git_excludes = true    # default
ignore_paths = []    # default
exclude = []    # default
path_case = "native"    # default
binary = "skip"    # default
max_file_size = "10M"    # default
encoding = "auto"    # default
# fallback_encoding =  (not set)    # default
archives = "none"    # default
max_archive_size = "100M"    # default
skip_generated = false    # file: conf/g.toml
```

2. `find`

```json request
{"query": "name ~ '*.rs'"}
```

```text response
files: 2  lines: 0  matches: 0  result: r1
#1 name ~ '*.rs'

src/
main.rs  [#1]
schema_gen.rs  [#1]
```

## E60.8 An invalid value in the config file

Fixture: `generated`

```toml conf/g.toml
[traversal]
skip_generated = "yes"
```

```text command
easy-peasy-mcp --config conf/g.toml
```

```text stderr exit 1
easy-peasy-mcp: conf/g.toml:2: invalid value for 'traversal.skip_generated': true or false is expected
```
